facts.summary: AK006 failed to beat placebo in CSU, program discontinued, 75% layoffs · Phase 1 · AK006 in chronic spontaneous urticaria · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The Company plans to discontinue AK006-related activities across clinical, manufacturing, research and administrative functions and reduce its workforce by approximately 75%.
